stories.title: Joshua Baez Makes MLB History — First Player Ever to Homer in Each of His First 3 Career At-Bats
stories.angle: Historical milestone — what it means, how rare, why it matters

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Joshua Baez just made MLB history.

He homered in each of his first 3 career at-bats.

No player had ever done that. Not once. Not in 150+ years of baseball.

Cards beat Cubs 8-4. Baez: 3-for-4, 5 RBI. First HR: 449 feet. 🔴 #STLCards

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Before last night, Joshua Baez led all of Triple-A with 34 home runs.

He had 30 family members in the Wrigley stands for his debut.

He hit a home run in all three of his first career at-bats.

First time ever in MLB history. #STLCards

article.headline: Joshua Baez Just Made History Nobody Had Ever Made Before

stories.title: Yordan Alvarez and the First Triple Crown in 14 Years — .329 BA, 36 HR, 88 RBI
stories.angle: Can Alvarez close the HR gap and become the first Triple Crown winner since Cabrera 2012?

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Yordan Alvarez leads all three Triple Crown categories:

→ .329 BA — leads MLB by .029+
→ 88 RBI — leads MLB by 7+
→ 36 HR — 1 behind Schwarber

Last Triple Crown winner: Cabrera, 2012.

Alvarez has 46 games to close it. #Astros

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
The HR gap is 1. Schwarber 37, Alvarez 36.

Schwarber hit 2 at the Field of Dreams game to grab the lead.

Alvarez leads BA by .029. Leads RBI by 7+.

If he passes Schwarber in HRs, Alvarez wins the Triple Crown. First since 2012. #Astros

stories.title: Brett Callahan Hits 2-Run Triple on First MLB Pitch — First Tiger to Do That Since 1912
stories.angle: Historic debut with a 114-year callback and full-circle alumni connection

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Brett Callahan's first MLB pitch: 2-run triple.

He became the first Tiger to hit a triple in his MLB debut since Ed Irwin in 1912.

That 1912 game? The famous Ty Cobb protest game. The pitcher? A St. Joseph's Univ. student.

Callahan also went to St. Joseph's. #Tigers

article.headline: Brett Callahan's First MLB Pitch Was a Triple — and the 1912 Connection Makes It Even Stranger
